findings: The complete view shows both mast sections, three nonadjustable tubular legs, three straps and distinct foot plates; no part is cropped in the default view.

Joint horizontal section exposes the actual hollow mast overlap and concave splice saddle. Lower creases and upper dimple are selected geometry supported by the source topology, not recovered manufacturer profiles.
Leg close-up shows flattened hollow ends, separate brace, pivot bores and foot anchoring holes. Upper/lower triangular clamps preserve separate radial bolt and inner/outer nut topology.
The 0.51 m footprint lacks a published datum. The selected centre-to-foot radius remains a spatial hypothesis.
Actual rigid-part intersections and openings are checked, with negative misaligned-dimple and unswaged-mast examples. These do not qualify torque, retention, loads or ground strength.
geometry_limits: Unpublished wall thickness, local profiles, fork shape, pivot sizes and all fastener lengths remain authored hypotheses.
Guy/ground kits and an earthen-site candidate are now available separately. Installed anchoring, level, attached equipment and initial-stock staging remain incomplete.
Current outdoor resin slab still conflicts with earth stakes; the reviewed earthen-site candidate has not replaced the main laboratory.
